scope: Committed-source qualification of restricted-role resume, host adoption, and default wake-home repair. Actual production caller and runtime activation remain separate acceptance steps.
rootCause: defaultEnsureCodexHomeForWake built an SU launch specification and called the SU home writer for every recorded role. Resume environment and host adoption had separately dropped the recorded role; those two earlier repairs are included in the qualified commit.
fix: Restricted wake recovery now calls the same repairRoleCodexHome implementation as interactive recovery. Missing or conflicting owner/role provenance refuses before either writer. Incomplete restricted repair cannot fall through to the SU writer.

distinguishingVerification.hypothesis: The production wake helper bypasses the restricted writer.
distinguishingVerification.alternativeHypothesis: The restricted writer is already selected and only native transport exposure is broken.
distinguishingVerification.procedure: Run the existing wake-executor-codex-home-repair suite before and after the source change; inspect restricted-writer, SU-writer and refusal assertions. Then run the existing launcher, serialized handoff and real PTY cases from the committed snapshot.

predictedObservations.hypothesis: The six role/route cases and provenance/incomplete-repair refusals fail before the change and pass after it.
predictedObservations.alternativeHypothesis: Those source-level cases pass before the change; native exposure can fail independently.
